statistical_endpoint_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 3A - Statistical Endpoint & Inference Specification

primary_endpoint.name: Paired Downside Shortfall Reduction on Defensive Sessions
primary_endpoint.conditioning_subset: Observed trading sessions where defensive regime is active (I_{def,t} = 1)
primary_endpoint.regime_trigger_definition: Defensive session active when market benchmark (SPY/QQQ) return R_{m,t} < 0 OR D2 asset allocation selects 50% defensive cash cushion
primary_endpoint.economic_interpretation: Measures dollar-for-dollar portfolio loss reduction achieved by D2's cash buffer during down-market days
primary_endpoint.minimum_effect_size_hurdle: delta_{min} = 0.0010 (10 basis points per defensive session)
primary_endpoint.justification_for_hurdle: Prevents claiming scientific success on economically trivial shortfall differences that would be eroded by cash management costs or slippage.

serial_correlation_and_heteroskedasticit.phenomenon: Financial down-sessions exhibit volatility clustering, serial autocorrelation, and leptokurtosis.
serial_correlation_and_heteroskedasticit.primary_hac_estimator: Newey-West (1987) Heteroskedasticity and Autocorrelation Consistent Covariance Estimator

non_parametric_validation.purpose: Protects against non-normality and temporal dependence without assuming asymptotic Gaussian distribution.

selection_bias_haircut.historical_context: At least 43 strategy variations were tested on historical Tier 1/Tier 2 data.
selection_bias_haircut.deflated_sharpe_ratio: Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014) DSR haircut framework applied to historical claims
selection_bias_haircut.prospective_independence: Prospective forward evaluation resets selection bias ONLY IF the evaluation design and parameters are locked irrevocably prior to observation start.

secondary_full_horizon_constraint.name: Full-Horizon Cumulative Return Drag Tolerance
secondary_full_horizon_constraint.economic_rationale: Holding 50% defensive cash during market upturns creates return drag. The owner establishes an insurance budget where D2 may not lag E0 by more than 200 bps annualized.

dual_decision_rule.condition_for_success: Primary test rejects H_0 (p_HAC < 0.05 and p_boot < 0.05) AND Secondary constraint holds (CAGR_{D2} >= CAGR_{E0} - 2.0%)
dual_decision_rule.condition_for_inconclusive: Primary test fails to reject H_0 OR Secondary constraint is breached
dual_decision_rule.condition_for_rejection: D2 suffers larger maximum drawdown than E0 in prospective testing

owner_action_required.action: Owner must formally ratify the 10 bps minimum hurdle and the 200 bps annual drag budget before evaluation begins.
